description: Descriptive requests for the real catalog. Each query avoids the literal catalog labels it should retrieve; 'accept' lists the genre or mood labels counted as relevant. Labels are weak (inherited from the Deezer playlist a track was found in), so precision is an approximate signal, not ground truth.
